*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Bosnia and Herzegovina floods]]
***Sixteen people are killed in [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[Jablanica, Bosnia and Herzegovina|Jablanica]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/4/bosnia-hit-by-heavy-floods-after-rainstorms-several-people-killed (Al Jazeera)]

[https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/river-level-amazon-rainforest-port-hits-122-year-low-amid-drought-2024-10-04/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Georgia–European Union relations]], [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union]]
**The [[European Union]] threatens [[Sanctions (law)|sanctions]] and a suspension of relations with [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] if Georgia becomes a "one-party state" with no [[List of political parties in Georgia (country)|political opposition]] following the [[2024 Georgian parliamentary election|next parliamentary elections]] on October 26. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-says-georgia-may-risk-sanctions-if-it-abandons-democracy-2024-10-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Parole for Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans]]
**The [[United States Department of Homeland Security]] reports that the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] will not renew the legal status of 530,000 [[immigration to the United States|migrants]] who entered the [[United States|U.S.]] as part of a provisional [[humanitarian]] program beginning in 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-will-not-renew-legal-status-hundreds-thousands-migrants-2024-10-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Pork barrel scam]]
**The [[Sandiganbayan]] court in the [[Philippines]] [[acquit]]s Chief Presidential Legal Counsel and [[President of the Senate of the Philippines|former Senate president]] [[Juan Ponce Enrile]], his former aide Gigi Reyes, and [[Janet Napoles]] of [[plunder]] in connection with the alleged misuse of Ponce Enrile's [[Priority Development Assistance Fund]] during his senatorial term. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/philippine-court-says-top-marcos-aide-not-guilty-graft-4658656 (AFP via CNA)] [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/sandiganbayan-decision-acquits-juan-ponce-enrile-plunder-pork-barrel-scam/ (Rappler)]
*[[Women's rights in Afghanistan]]
**The [[European Court of Justice]] rules that all [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] women are eligible for [[right of asylum|asylum]] in the [[European Union]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/law/2024/oct/04/eu-court-rules-gender-and-nationality-enough-to-grant-afghan-women-asylum (''The Guardian'')]
*At least two people are killed and three others are injured, including one critically, in a suspected [[arson]] at a 100-year-old three-story building in the [[Old Montreal]] neighbourhood of [[Montreal]], [[Quebec]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/fire-notre-dame-bonsecours-old-montreal-restaurant-1.7342546 (CBC News)] [https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/2-dead-after-fire-rips-through-historic-building-in-old-montreal-1.7061973 (CFCF-TV)]
*A woman from [[Toronto]], [[Ontario]], Canada, is arrested and charged with [[murder]] following a [[Spree killer|stabbing spree]] that killed three people in Toronto, [[Niagara Falls, Ontario|Niagara Falls]] and [[Hamilton, Ontario|Hamilton]] between Tuesday and Thursday. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/police-arrest-toronto-woman-in-connection-with-three-recent-homicides-1.7062666 (CFTO-TV)]
